propositions: A new advisory LLM criterion must deterministically route only when persisted file_impact_scope is exactly 'none', excluding 'paths', 'undeclared', missing, None, and unknown values.

The criterion must judge whether a ticket declaring no repository-file impact actually describes work requiring file changes, returning PASS for external-only deliverables and advisory findings for required repository edits.

The exact persisted no_file_impact_reason must round-trip through deterministic JSON structured context into the production Pass-1 LLM request, with missing reasons serializing as an explicit empty string.

Criterion applicability must extend the shared routing validator in overlay.py to accept require_file_impact_scope as a non-empty list of strings, and registry.applies() must accept file_impact_scope as a keyword parameter.
Advisory contradictions and non-blocking insufficient-evidence coaching must not block ticket claim, preserving fail-open behavior in the existing Pass-1 advisory framework.
